data.note:
Reflection on s_9b92bf868e (camptothecin, PubChem CID 24360, ChEMBL CHEMBL65, no curated mechanism in ChEMBL e20, BBBC021 annotated DNA replication):

I concluded Microtubule stabilizers (p=0.58) and was incorrect. True class per code is DNA replication.

What went wrong: At 0.03 uM I correctly measured DNA replication phenotype - massive nuclear enlargement nuc_area z=27.9, cell_area z=12.6, frac_large_nucleus z=7.27 (e8). This matches topoisomerase I inhibition by camptothecin causing S-phase arrest and nuclear swelling, classically described for camptothecins and beyond (PMID 16990856). At 0.1 uM a transitional actin-centric appearance (act_std z=21 e2, microscopist Actin disruptors e4) was already confounded. At 1-3 uM toxicity dominated: cell shrinkage, nuclear condensation (nuc_area z=-24 to -26 e7/e3), cell_roundness increase z=23, and artefactual tubulin signal brightening tub_glcm_contrast z=29-82 and tub_mean z=22-45 (e7/e3) with tub_glcm_contrast dose response rho=1.0 e12. I over-weighted this high-dose tubulin texture and the microscopist's Microtubule stabilizer call e13, and a weak mitotic-like increase e9 (from -1 to +18 but only 26 cells measured at 3uM, low viability).

The atlas should have warned me: NSC vote was 2/4 DNA replication vs 2/4 Cholesterol-lowering e14, 1/2 earlier e6, with very low similarities 0.43-0.54, and k=10 mean similarity only 0.39 for stabilizers - weak evidence that should not outweigh the low-dose specific phenotype. I discounted the NSC as noise and chased the dramatic high-dose actin/tubulin z-scores, which are non-specific in cell death.

Lesson: For topoisomerase I inhibitors (PMID 16990856, PMID 2557085, PMID 8305535), prioritize low-dose nuclear enlargement / DNA-content increase and treat high-dose tubulin brightening, cell rounding and extreme contrast variances as secondary cytotoxicity, not mechanism. Requires dose-response validation and orthogonal S-phase/phospho-H2AX assay.

reflection.text: We were wrong: truth was camptothecin / DNA replication (topoisomerase I inhibitor, PMID 16990856, PMID 8305535, PMID 2557085) and we concluded Microtubule stabilizers 0.58. What got right but we missed: low-dose e8 (0.03uM, 221 cells) showed nuc_area z+28.0, cell_area +12.6, major axis +13.6 - classic nuclear enlargement from replication stress, not stabilizer. The dose-responses e11 nuc_area rho=-1.00 and e10 frac_large_nucleus rho=-0.95 captured the biphasic enlargement at low dose then shrinkage at high dose; we mis-assigned the enlargement to Aurora (e17) then dismissed it. Crucially compare_to_reference e6 (NSC 1/2 DNA replication) and e14 (2/4 DNA replication) correctly flagged the true class but we down-weighted it as 'low-similarity' and favored k-neighbour 7/10 then 5/10 Microtubule stabilizers. What misled us: high-dose cytotoxic artifacts e3 (3uM, 26 cells: act_std +108.2, tub_glcm_contrast +82.8) and e7 (1uM, 56 cells: tub_glcm_contrast +29.5, nuc_area -24.4) with e12 tub contrast rho=+1.00 and e16 act_std rho=+1.00 plus e13 microscopist 'Microtubule stabilizers' on 2 fields. We read monotonic condensation/rounding and cell loss (e4 density lower, e15 cell_count rho=-0.80) as specific bundling/stabilization. Acquisition choice amplified this: only 4 wells single-replicate, starting with 3uM then 1uM, leaving dose_response n=4 underpowered (e9 p=0.2), and only 2 fields per describe_phenotype giving conflicting density calls (e4 lower vs e5/e13 higher). ## Conclusion

**Microtubule stabilizers** (stated probability 0.58); key evidence e3, e7, e12, e9, e13, e11.

Why: High-dose tubulin intensity/bundling and mitotic arrest outweigh low-similarity NSC; dose responses converge on stabilization.

## PI review

Verdict: approve.

Approve: 0.58 for Microtubule stabilizers is calibrated. Across four independent doses, tubulin contrast/mean, mitotic-like fraction and cell rounding rise monotonically (tubulin contrast z 0.8 to 82.8; mitotic z -1.7 to +18.0) with nuclear/cell shrinkage, opposite to destabilizer or Aurora expectations. Low-dose actin/large-nucleus signals explain the runner-ups but are superseded at 1-3 µM. ## Unblinding

Compound: **camptothecin** (PubChem CID [24360](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/24360))

Identity check: name and BBBC021 structure agree

ChEMBL mechanisms: no curated mechanism in ChEMBL

## Verdict (computed by code)

Incorrect: agent said **Microtubule stabilizers**, BBBC021 annotates **DNA replication**.

## Reflection

We were wrong: truth was camptothecin / DNA replication (topoisomerase I inhibitor, PMID 16990856, PMID 8305535, PMID 2557085) and we concluded Microtubule stabilizers 0.58. What got right but we missed: low-dose e8 (0.03uM, 221 cells) showed nuc_area z+28.0, cell_area +12.6, major axis +13.6 - classic nuclear enlargement from replication stress, not stabilizer. The dose-responses e11 nuc_area rho=-1.00 and e10 frac_large_nucleus rho=-0.95 captured the biphasic enlargement at low dose then shrinkage at high dose; we mis-assigned the enlargement to Aurora (e17) then dismissed it. What misled us: high-dose cytotoxic artifacts e3 (3uM, 26 cells: act_std +108.2, tub_glcm_contrast +82.8) and e7 (1uM, 56 cells: tub_glcm_contrast +29.5, nuc_area -24.4) with e12 tub contrast rho=+1.00 and e16 act_std rho=+1.00 plus e13 microscopist 'Microtubule stabilizers' on 2 fields. We read monotonic condensation/rounding and cell loss (e4 density lower, e15 cell_count rho=-0.80) as specific bundling/stabilization. Acquisition choice amplified this: only 4 wells single-replicate, starting with 3uM then 1uM, leaving dose_response n=4 underpowered (e9 p=0.2), and only 2 fields per describe_phenotype giving conflicting density calls (e4 lower vs e5/e13 higher). We should have weighted the high-cell-count low-dose phenotype and the split NSC signal over high-dose texture with <60 cells.

What was right:
- e8 nuc enlargement, e6/e14 NSC DNA replication 1/2 and 2/4
- e11/e10 biphasic nuclear size

What was wrong or missed:
- e3/e7/e12/e16 tub/actin texture misread as bundling - actually cytotoxic condensation
- e13 subjective stabilizer call and e6/e14 k-neighbour 7/10->5/10 over-weighted

Proposed next experiment: low-dose 0.01-0.1uM replicate matrix with DNA replication markers (EdU, pH2AX) vs tubulin polymerization assay; do not rely on high-dose texture alone
